method: Every live fact was read. Decisions: reg-decisions.json; patches: reg-patches/ (built by reg_build.py, which checks every number-free display against the 8-word limit and the normalized quotes); commands run one by one by reg_run.py (logs reg-run-*.log); checks: reg_check.py; demand merge: reg_demand.py.
rules_applied: Duplicates: superseded when two facts quote the same sentence (kept the fact with the more direct quote, the scope or the faq- id for the FAQ quick-fire); composites whose parts have their own facts were superseded (cannot-pass-ec2-limit, lifecycle-hook-timeouts, warm-pool-no-minimum-size-default) or cut to their own part (instance-refresh-min-max-healthy, replace-root-volume-requirements, warm-pool-states, wa-replaces-unhealthy-instance, change-instance-refresh-alarm-rollback-2023, max-instance-lifetime-min-one-day).
Bullets, the higher exam relevance and hard were carried from each superseded fact to the kept fact.
Displays without a number: a verbatim phrase of at most 8 words from a quote (RULINGS 2026-10-11); about 200 long or claim-only displays replaced or dropped.

FAQ and pricing-page facts that shared a quote: the FAQ fact keeps only its FAQ quote (aws-auto-scaling-faq-free-cloudwatch-fees-apply, ec2-auto-scaling-faq-no-additional-fees); the pricing page quote stays in the pricing-page facts.
Scope filled on 351 facts that had none.
Bullets given to the two facts that had none (interface endpoint, service-linked role): 2.2.S1.
